propositions: Both config ownership and field consumption gates must run through the single make lint target to serve as the portable primary trigger, with CI inheriting them via the existing make lint step rather than invoking gates directly
The standalone 'Config-read gate' workflow step must be removed to eliminate double-run and redundancy now that both gates are consolidated in make lint
Workflow-parity tests must assert that removing either gate invocation from the Makefile lint target or removing make lint from the workflow causes test failures
The test_ci_wires_the_gate assertion must be re-anchored from the workflow file to the Makefile to reflect the new gate invocation location
